recommendation.reason: Agentic benchmark with public browser-game tasks, executable verifier, strong diversity and real artifacts; best score 55.29% leaves room.
risks: Reward hacking not addressed in the pages
Top models evaluated with only one run per task
No human review of task construction is stated

release.quote: **GameWorld** benchmarks multimodal game agents across 34 games and 170 tasks in a browser-based environment, using outcome-based, state-verifiable evaluation.

redistribution_questions: The licence field is None for the benchmark repo, so it is unknown whether the code may be redistributed.
The 34 games are cloned from a separate repo (gameworld-project/GameWorld-Games) whose licence is not stated, so game asset redistribution is unsettled.
The trajectory dataset on Hugging Face (yyyang/gameworld-benchmark-trajectories) has no stated licence.

tasks.quote: Each model was evaluated on 170 tasks with a 400-step limit per run.

verifier.full_credit: Task success is scored from game-state snapshots by the task evaluator; SR is the success rate.
verifier.quote:
class Evaluator:
    """Task evaluator that consumes game-state snapshots."""

services: game server on a base port (default 8101)
optional local model server via vLLM
network_or_api: vLLM local model endpoint, e.g. vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B --port 8088
exceptions: The game library is not in this repo and must be cloned separately: git clone https://github.com/gameworld-project/GameWorld-Games.git games/gameworld-games
The recommended Fine-Control Protocol lives on branch fine-control-400-steps-202608
runtime.quote:
conda create -n gameworld python=3.12
conda activate gameworld
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium

questions: Where do the 34 games come from, and is the separate GameWorld-Games clone required before anything runs?
What licence covers the benchmark code, the game library, and the trajectory dataset?
How is a single task identified for a container run, given presets like 10_doodle-jump+10_01+gpt-5.2?
Which state snapshot and evaluation.json fields does the container verifier read to score a task?
readiness.next_action: Clone both GameWorld and GameWorld-Games, install the Python/browser deps, and run 'python human_play.py --game 10_doodle-jump' to confirm the browser runtime before wiring the verifier.
